log_level.description: Global log verbosity: debug, info, notice, warning, error, critical, alert, emerg

config_storage.description: Configuration storage backend (e.g., File, JSON, YAML, DBI, Redis)

session_storage.description: Session storage backend and its options

portal_url.description: Public-facing URL of the LemonLDAP::NG portal (e.g., for redirect URIs)

management_url.description: Optional management portal URL (if separate from main portal)

request_timeout.description: Timeout (seconds) for external requests (e.g., configuration backend queries)

workers.description: Number of worker processes (0 means dynamic, use 0 for production with systemd socket activation)

ports.description: List of TCP ports to listen on for FastCGI connections

sockets.description: List of Unix socket paths to bind to (for local proxying, e.g., via nginx)

user.description: System user to drop privileges to (must exist)

group.description: System group to drop privileges to

pid_file.description: Path to store the FastCGI process ID file (disable with empty string)

graceful_reload.description: Enable graceful reload on SIGHUP (recommended for zero-downtime updates)

backend.description: Logging backend module (e.g., File, Console, Syslog)

file.description: Log file path (used when backend is File)
